text: {"entries":[{"name_han":"青囊经","logic_thesis":"The text proves that terrestrial fortune is not random decoration of landscape but a lawful transmission of cosmic qi through measurable form: heaven’s pattern becomes earth’s body, and body becomes human outcome. If qi has direction, concentration, and depletion, then burial and dwelling sites can be ranked by how well they store and release that qi. Therefore geomancy is a causal technology of qi economy, not omen-hunting.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Heaven’s qi moves by yin–yang and five-phase law and must settle into earth to become usable life-force. 2. Inference: Earth forms (mountains, waters, voids) are the only durable vessels that can receive, store, or leak that qi. 3. Inference: Where form gathers and water embraces without scattering, qi accumulates; where form breaks or water rushes, qi disperses. 4. Inference: Accumulated qi nourishes the living line; dispersed qi starves it. 5. Conclusion: Ranking sites by storage–release structure is a rational causal method for shaping lineage outcomes.","logic_practice":"1. Map a site first as a qi circuit (source → path → store → exit), not as aesthetic scenery. 2. Prefer configurations where mountain backs store and water fronts contain, avoiding open leaks. 3. Treat burial/home placement as timing of release: too tight stagnates, too open drains. 4. In BaZi terms, read environmental support as external ‘season/root’ that can reinforce or starve a chart’s weak elements. 5. Reject purely symbolic names of peaks; demand form that actually holds wind and water.","logic_compare":"Unlike 葬经翼, which elaborates burial craft after the classical axiom, 青囊经 states the first causal law itself: heaven–earth–man as one qi process. Unlike 青囊奥语, it argues principle more than operational formula, establishing why form matters before how to measure it."},{"name_han":"天玉经","logic_thesis":"The text proves that correct form alone is insufficient: directional degrees, mountain–water correspondence, and yin–yang pairing must lock into a single coordinate system or qi will be mis-assigned. It demonstrates that ‘sitting and facing’ are not aesthetic choices but algebraic relations between heavenly stems/branches and earthly landforms. Therefore error in orientation converts a good form into a wrong usage of qi.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Qi has both shape (form) and address (direction under the sexagenary/compass grid). 2. Inference: A form that stores qi still delivers it only along the facing/sitting axis that matches the mountain–water pair. 3. Inference: Mismatched mountain and water (or wrong degree) sends the stored qi to the wrong ‘palace’ of destiny. 4. Inference: Yin–yang and pure/impure lines must pair; unpaired lines cancel or invert benefit. 5. Conclusion: Geomantic validity is form × orientation × pairing, not form by itself.","logic_practice":"1. Never score a site without measured sitting/facing degrees on a calibrated luopan logic. 2. Check mountain–water as a pair: water must ‘report’ to the mountain’s useful sector. 3. Separate pure and impure lines; do not mix formulas that assume different grids. 4. For BaZi integration, treat house orientation as a fixed external stem–branch field that biases yearly luck. 5. When form is good but life fails, audit orientation before abandoning the site.","logic_compare":"Compared with 青囊经’s general qi economy, 天玉经 is the coordinate theorem: it proves addressability of qi. Compared with 都天宝照经, it is more abstract and pairing-centered, less a practical ‘mirror’ of case-like rules for reading bright hall and water exits."},{"name_han":"都天宝照经","logic_thesis":"The text proves that the ‘bright hall,’ water mouth, and surrounding forms act as a readable instrument panel of fortune, not mystical scenery. By treating landscape as a system of intake, holding, and discharge, it shows outcomes can be predicted from how openly qi is received and how cleanly it exits. Thus feng shui judgment is diagnostic observation of circulatory health.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Usable qi must enter a bounded court, rest, then leave without tearing the vessel. 2. Inference: The bright hall is the reception chamber; too cramped or too wild ruins reception quality. 3. Inference: The water mouth is the control valve of discharge; its position and tightness regulate retention of wealth/rank qi. 4. Inference: Surrounding sand (hills) are walls of the vessel; broken walls equal leakage of social protection. 5. Conclusion: Reading hall–mouth–sand as one hydraulic system yields reliable ranking of sites.","logic_practice":"1. Photograph/sketch the bright hall depth and openness before any formula talk. 2. Locate water exit relative to sitting mountain; treat it as the wealth lock. 3. Score enclosing hills as protection layers (left–right–front–back). 4. Prefer sites with calm intake and controlled exit over dramatic but leaking vistas. 5. In cultivation/BaZi use, treat a good hall as ‘seasonal support’ that stabilizes weak day-master expression.","logic_compare":"Unlike 天玉经’s abstract pairing algebra, 都天宝照经 argues from visible circulatory anatomy—more phenomenological ‘mirror.’ Unlike 催官篇, it is general fortune diagnostics, not specialized promotion of official rank via specific form signatures."},{"name_han":"催官篇","logic_thesis":"The text proves that official rank is not generic ‘good feng shui’ but a specific morphological signature: forms that gather noble qi, open court for public recognition, and water/sand patterns that push career force rather than mere private wealth. It argues causality from shape-language of power (authority peaks, ceremonial halls, orderly attendants) to social elevation. Therefore career geomancy is a specialized subset of form science with its own evidence criteria.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Social rank is a public, hierarchical form of qi expression, not private accumulation alone. 2. Inference: Landscapes that resemble orderly courts, honor guards, and commanding peaks encode that hierarchical qi. 3. Inference: Water and road ‘approaches’ that bow and report generate recognition pathways; chaotic approaches generate litigation or obscurity. 4. Inference: Timing of burial/use can ‘urge’ (cui) latent noble qi into career manifestation. 5. Conclusion: Official success can be engineered by matching rank-shaped landforms plus activation timing.","logic_practice":"1. Separate wealth-forms from rank-forms when auditing a site; do not confuse cash flow with office. 2. Seek orderly, upright peaks and ceremonial bright halls for career cases. 3. Check approach paths/waters for ‘reporting’ geometry toward the seat. 4. Use burial or renovation timing to catalyze, not only static form. 5. In BaZi, pair rank sites with charts that already have officer/kill structure so environment amplifies, not invents, capacity.","logic_compare":"Differs from 都天宝照经 by specializing the circulatory model into status outcomes. Differs from BaZi rank methods in 三命通会/子平真诠: here the proof object is land morphology as external officer-star, not natal stem–branch officer combinations."},{"name_han":"发微论","logic_thesis":"Cai Yuanding’s text proves that feng shui’s true object is subtle pattern (li) and qi process, not vulgar tricks of shape-naming. It argues that only by tracing how yin–yang, five phases, and form–qi co-arise can one move from superstition to reasoned micro-analysis. Therefore ‘fa wei’ (revealing the subtle) is an epistemological reform: visibility of principle over rote secret formulas.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Popular geomancy often freezes forms into lucky/unlucky labels without causal process. 2. Inference: Real efficacy depends on li–qi dynamics: generation, control, balance, timing. 3. Inference: Form is the coarse body of qi; without reading subtle transitions, form-reading is incomplete. 4. Inference: Scholarly method must make those transitions explicit and teachable. 5. Conclusion: Geomancy is rehabilitated as rational investigation of subtle cosmic–terrestrial process.","logic_practice":"1. For any rule, ask ‘what qi process does this encode?’ before applying it. 2. Prefer dynamic balance analysis (excess/deficiency, open/closed) over fixed taboo lists. 3. Train observation of micro-changes: wind turns, water speed, slope transitions. 4. Cross-check land analysis with BaZi seasonality language (same five-phase logic). 5. Discard secretisms that cannot state a causal chain.","logic_compare":"Unlike 青囊奥语’s mnemonic formulas, 发微论 argues for transparent principle and intellectual purification. Unlike 青囊经, which founds the system mythically–axiomatically, it is Song rationalist methodology: why and how we know, not only that qi settles in form."},{"name_han":"青囊序","logic_thesis":"The preface proves that the Qingnang corpus is a transmission lineage with ordered method: heaven’s principle, earth’s application, and human use must be sequenced, or later techniques become orphaned tricks. It argues legitimacy of practice by genealogy of understanding—principle first, technique second. Therefore authority in geomancy is correct sequence of learning, not accumulation of secret tips.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Fragmentary techniques without framework produce contradictory judgments. 2. Inference: A proper ‘xu’ (ordering preface) establishes the map: cosmos → earth vessel → human timing. 3. Inference: Later formulas only work inside that map. 4. Inference: Transmission ethics require preserving sequence so students do not invert means and ends. 5. Conclusion: Methodological order is itself a causal condition of correct feng shui.","logic_practice":"1. Teach/learn in order: yin–yang/five phases → form storage → compass pairing → case application. 2. When a formula conflicts, return to the higher premise in the sequence rather than stacking more tricks. 3. Use the preface as a checklist that each analysis has principle, form, and human timing layers. 4. In BaZi parallel, do not jump to special gods before chart structure is clear. 5. Audit your own practice for inverted sequence (tools before theory).","logic_compare":"Unlike 青囊经 proper, which states cosmic axioms, 青囊序 argues the pedagogical and epistemological order of the system. Unlike 青囊奥语, it is not operational verse but meta-logic of how the school’s knowledge must be held together."},{"name_han":"青囊奥语","logic_thesis":"The text proves that Yang-school efficacy can be compressed into operational couplets: dragon, sand, water, and orientation interact by fixed generative rules that can be chanted and applied. It treats occult complexity as reducible to portable decision algorithms. Therefore the ‘mystery’ is not ineffability but condensed protocol for field use.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Masters need fast, stable rules under field conditions. 2. Inference: Complex qi relations can be encoded as short conditional verses (if dragon X and water Y, then Z). 3. Inference: Memorized protocols reduce interpretive drift between practitioners. 4. Inference: Practice fidelity becomes repeatability of the algorithm, not personal inspiration. 5. Conclusion: Geomantic art is transmissible as formulaic logic, not only as ineffable intuition.","logic_practice":"1. Convert each couplet into an if–then checklist on site. 2. Verify dragon–water–sand–orientation as four independent inputs before concluding. 3. Use the verses as constraints that can falsify a ‘pretty’ but invalid site. 4. Pair with measurement (degrees, water exit) so poetry does not float free of data. 5. For BaZi, treat such protocols as analogous to structural yongshen rules: short, testable, hierarchical.","logic_compare":"Differs from 发微论 by prioritizing portable formula over philosophical unpacking. Differs from 天玉经 by being more mnemonic and applied; 天玉经 proves coordinate necessity, while 奥语 packages multi-factor decisions for workers in the field."},{"name_han":"麻衣神相","logic_thesis":"The text proves that the body’s surface is a lawful map of inner qi, character, and destiny because form follows the same yin–yang/five-phase economy as heaven and earth. If facial bones, flesh, and spirit-color are stable expressions of that economy, then life outcomes can be inferred from structured signs rather than from caprice. Therefore physiognomy is a diagnostic science of embodied pattern, not carnival guesswork.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Human life is qi–form unity; character and fate are not purely invisible. 2. Inference: Face and body crystallize long-term qi states into readable morphology. 3. Inference: Hierarchy of signs exists (bone/spirit over temporary flesh/color). 4. Inference: Combinations and contradictions among signs yield nuanced, not one-feature, verdicts. 5. Conclusion: Systematic xiang can predict tendency of fortune and virtue with disciplined observation.","logic_practice":"1. Read bone structure and spiritual light before scars, makeup, or mood. 2. Use five-phase face zoning (wood/fire/earth/metal/water regions) as elemental diagnostics. 3. Resolve conflicts by weighting permanent signs over transient ones. 4. Cross-check with BaZi: face as ‘phenotypic output’ of natal balance. 5. Never conclude from a single auspicious feature without whole-face synthesis.","logic_compare":"Unlike 冰鉴, which is moral-psychological and elite-selection oriented, 麻衣神相 is classical full destiny physiognomy with stronger fate cataloguing. Unlike 柳庄相法, it is more foundational-legendary corpus than a later refined clinical system of weighted detail."},{"name_han":"柳庄相法","logic_thesis":"The text proves that physiognomy becomes more reliable when observation is standardized into fine-grained modules—features, proportions, spirit, and dynamic expression—with explicit weighting. It argues that accuracy rises by methodical decomposition and recombination rather than by mystical ‘overall feel’ alone. Therefore high-level xiang is an engineering of attention.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Global impressions are biased and non-replicable across readers. 2. Inference: Breaking the face into ordered feature modules reduces noise. 3. Inference: Assigning relative strength (main vs secondary signs) prevents equal false weighting. 4. Inference: Dynamic signs (voice, gait, spirit) update static bone readings. 5. Conclusion: A modular, weighted protocol yields more stable judgments of character and luck.","logic_practice":"1. Follow a fixed exam order (spirit → bone → organs → color → motion). 2. Score each module and only then synthesize. 3. Let conflicting modules produce conditional predictions, not forced unity. 4. Use motion/spirit to validate whether ‘good bone’ is currently usable qi. 5. In BaZi counselling, treat modular xiang as life-stage feedback on whether the chart is expressing.","logic_compare":"Compared with 麻衣神相, 柳庄 is more clinical-systematizing and less mythic. Compared with 神相全编, it is a coherent school method rather than a broad encyclopedia of many sources and techniques."},{"name_han":"神相全编","logic_thesis":"The compilation proves that physiognomic truth is distributed across many partial traditions and becomes stronger when collated, compared, and completed into a full reference system. It argues that no single thin manual covers the combinatorial space of human form; encyclopedic integration is required for professional coverage. Therefore completeness and cross-checking are epistemic virtues in xiang studies.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Human variation exceeds any short classic’s example set. 2. Inference: Multiple lineages capture different edge cases and feature logics. 3. Inference: Compilation allows triangulation when one school’s sign is ambiguous. 4. Inference: A ‘quan bian’ (complete compilation) functions as a decision library, not a single theorem. 5. Conclusion: Best practice is multi-source synthesis under unified five-phase principles.","logic_practice":"1. When a case is odd, consult multiple modules (palm, face, body, moles) rather than forcing one classic. 2. Prefer agreements among independent sign systems as higher confidence. 3. Use the book as a library of differentials, not as contradictory oracles. 4. Map diverse signs back to one BaZi elemental story to avoid scatter. 5. Document which sub-tradition a rule comes from to prevent category errors.","logic_compare":"Differs from 麻衣/柳庄 as encyclopedic aggregation versus single-voice method. Differs from 相理衡真, which tries to weigh and purify principles toward ‘truth balance,’ whereas 全编 prioritizes breadth of coverage over critical filtration."},{"name_han":"冰鉴","logic_thesis":"Zeng Guofan’s text proves that appearance is a practical instrument for reading moral fiber, talent type, and reliability under pressure—especially for selecting people—because spirit, bone, and qi-color reveal disposition more quickly than words. It is less about fatalistic fortune-telling than about risk management in human capital. Therefore physiognomy is justified as political–organizational epistemology.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Organizations fail when character is misread. 2. Inference: Speech is strategic; bodily spirit and structure are harder to fake continuously. 3. Inference: Categories of talent (steady, fierce, cunning, pure) map to observable constellations of features and demeanor. 4. Inference: Selection decisions improve by disciplined cold observation (‘ice’ clarity). 5. Conclusion: Xiang is a tool of governance and self-cultivation through knowing men—including oneself.","logic_practice":"1. Observe silence, eyes, and bone before trusting rhetoric. 2. Match role requirements to talent type, not generic ‘good face.’ 3. Use xiang for risk flags (instability, cruelty, frailty) in partnerships. 4. Apply inward: correct your own qi-color via sleep, virtue, and posture (cultivation loop). 5. With BaZi, use 冰鉴 as interview layer validating chart-indicated character tendencies.","logic_compare":"Unlike 麻衣神相’s destiny catalogs, 冰鉴 is selection ethics and talent typology for statesmen. Unlike 水镜集, its tone is Confucian-practical and terse, not primarily esoteric destiny elaboration."},{"name_han":"相理衡真","logic_thesis":"The text proves that physiognomy needs a truth-balancing method: principles must be weighed against each other so that vulgar absolute rules are corrected by higher li. It argues that ‘true’ xiang is calibrated judgment under conflicting signs, not maximal collection of omens. Therefore hermeneutic balance is the core skill.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Many transmitted rules conflict when applied raw. 2. Inference: Without a balancing standard, practitioners oscillate or cherry-pick. 3. Inference: Higher principles (spirit over form, whole over part, enduring over transient) adjudicate conflicts. 4. Inference: ‘Heng zhen’ means continuous calibration toward reality, including moral reality. 5. Conclusion: Valid physiognomy is principled arbitration among signs, not sum of taboos.","logic_practice":"1. Always state the conflict explicitly before resolving it. 2. Apply hierarchy: spirit/bone > flesh/color > isolated moles/marks. 3. Test a reading against known life facts to recalibrate weights. 4. Refuse lucrative absolute claims when balance is unclear. 5. In BaZi parallel, practice the same: balance useful god vs taboo god under season, not slogan rules.","logic_compare":"Unlike 神相全编’s expansive compilation, 相理衡真 is critical and adjudicative. Unlike 柳庄’s modular protocol, it focuses on philosophical weighing when modules disagree—the meta-logic of truthfulness in reading."},{"name_han":"水镜集","logic_thesis":"The text proves that destiny-reflection works like a water mirror: the stiller and clearer the reflective medium (method and mind), the more accurate the image of a person’s fate-pattern. It binds technique to contemplative clarity, arguing that muddy desire distorts reading as much as wrong theory. Therefore xiang is both optical science of form and cultivation of the reader.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Reading is representation; representation fails when the mirror is turbid. 2. Inference: Technical rules are the mirror’s polish; moral/psychological stillness is the water’s calm. 3. Inference: Distorted motive (fear, greed, flattery) bends interpretation. 4. Inference: Clear method + clear mind yields high-fidelity mapping from form to life pattern. 5. Conclusion: Epistemic purity of the practitioner is part of the causal chain of accurate physiognomy.","logic_practice":"1. Stabilize breath and motive before reading anyone. 2. Separate observation notes from evaluative judgment in two passes. 3. Re-check conclusions after emotional neutrality returns. 4. Use water-mirror metaphor in cultivation: clarify jing–qi–shen to clarify perception. 5. Integrate with BaZi without forcing client-pleasing narratives.","logic_compare":"Differs from 冰鉴 by more explicitly fusing contemplative metaphor with destiny reading. Differs from 麻衣’s external sign catalogs by stressing the reader’s internal condition as a validity condition of knowledge."},{"name_han":"葬经翼","logic_thesis":"As ‘wings’ to the burial classic, the text proves that classical burial axioms become operational only when expanded into detailed mechanisms of dragon veins, points, sands, and waters with error analysis. It argues that incomplete application of 葬经 principles causes false blame of the classic rather than of technique. Therefore commentary-elaboration is necessary causal completion of theory.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Core burial classic states condensed laws of resting the dead to affect the living. 2. Inference: Real terrain is complex; without wings (detailed extensions), users misidentify points. 3. Inference: Detailed failure modes (false dragons, greedy points, leaking waters) explain bad outcomes. 4. Inference: Corrective elaboration restores the classic’s predictive power. 5. Conclusion: Geomantic classics require technical midrash to function as applied science.","logic_practice":"1. Locate true dragon and true point with multi-factor confirmation, not single omen. 2. Study classic failure cases: beautiful form with wrong point. 3. Treat burial as systems engineering: protection, storage, drainage. 4. Use 葬经翼 as a debugging manual when classical expectations fail. 5. Link to BaZi timing for burial/move dates so form and time cohere.","logic_compare":"Unlike 青囊经’s foundational axioms, 葬经翼 is applied expansion and troubleshooting. Unlike 催官篇’s rank specialization, it remains general burial-science completion of the classical line rather than a narrow career manual."},{"name_han":"三命通会","logic_thesis":"The work proves that destiny calculation becomes robust only when the three systems of fate discourse (and the vast combinatorial library of stem–branch cases) are integrated into one comprehensive reference. It argues that isolated techniques produce partial truths; encyclopedic synthesis under calendar cosmology yields professional completeness. Therefore BaZi mastery is corpus-level pattern recognition across many verified combinations.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Human natal patterns are combinatorially huge. 2. Inference: No short theory covers all interactions of gods, shrines, and structures. 3. Inference: A tonghui (complete assembly) stores precedent logic for rare charts. 4. Inference: Cross-section of schools allows correction of one-sided doctrines. 5. Conclusion: Reliable practice is theory + large case grammar, not theory alone.","logic_practice":"1. Use it as a differential library when a chart’s pattern is uncommon. 2. Always re-derive a cited rule from structure before applying it blindly. 3. Compare multiple entries on the same topic to extract invariant logic. 4. Build personal case notes that update the book’s medieval priors. 5. Combine with modern timing practice carefully—prefer structural principles over archaic fatal lists.","logic_compare":"Unlike 渊海子平, which founds Zi Ping method, 三命通会 is the massive consolidation layer. Unlike 滴天髓, it is less pure philosophical distillation and more encyclopedic coverage of gods, verses, and categories."},{"name_han":"渊海子平","logic_thesis":"The text proves that destiny can be computed from the four pillars’ stem–branch structure by reading self (day master) against climate of month, roots, combinations, and useful relations—without relying solely on year-animal folklore. It establishes Zi Ping as a structural algebra of birth time. Therefore personal fate analysis is a chart-internal logic of balance and function.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Birth time fixes a four-layer stem–branch matrix of qi. 2. Inference: The day stem is the subject; other characters are environment and resources. 3. Inference: Strength and usefulness depend on month command, roots, and generation/control links. 4. Inference: Combinations, clashes, and deities/gods are operators on that structure. 5. Conclusion: Life tendencies follow from structural balance, not from isolated symbolic animals.","logic_practice":"1. Identify day master and month command first every time. 2. Map roots and seasonal empowerment before listing lucky gods. 3. Determine what the chart needs (support, output, wealth, officer control) as functional demand. 4. Read luck cycles as changing climate over a fixed structure. 5. Reject year-only popular readings that ignore the matrix.","logic_compare":"Compared with 子平真诠, 渊海子平 is the oceanic foundational curriculum; 真诠 later purifies structure-first method. Compared with 穷通宝鉴, it is broader structural Zi Ping rather than a climate/season specialist treatise on stem–branch temperature."},{"name_han":"滴天髓","logic_thesis":"The text proves that true BaZi judgment is not stacking of auspicious labels but perceiving the living pattern of qi—when it flows, sticks, rebels, or transforms—through elegant structural insight. It argues that celestial ‘marrow’ is pattern recognition of balance and timing at a high abstraction. Therefore advanced destiny reading is poetic-precise philosophy of structure, not catalog of taboos.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Many schools drown in named gods while missing overall qi dynamics. 2. Inference: A chart is a living ecology: generating paths, blockages, and warps matter more than decorative stars. 3. Inference: Success comes when mechanism is understood (how wealth is taken, how officer is controlled). 4. Inference: Language of classics should point to mechanism, not replace it. 5. Conclusion: Highest skill is seeing marrow-level structure that explains all surface gods.","logic_practice":"1. After standard setup, write the chart’s ‘story of flow’ in one paragraph without god-names. 2. Identify the main blockage or main engine first. 3. Evaluate ten gods only as roles inside that engine. 4. Use luck pillars as weather that enables or disables the mechanism. 5. In cultivation, treat the chart’s imbalance as a map of which virtues/practices restore flow.","logic_compare":"Unlike 渊海子平’s foundational breadth, 滴天髓 is refined theory of insight. Unlike 子平真诠’s clean pedagogical structure of useful gods, it is more metaphysical-literary, demanding higher abstraction; 真诠 is clearer for stepwise training, 滴天髓 for master-level pattern vision."},{"name_han":"穷通宝鉴","logic_thesis":"The text proves that a stem’s fortune depends primarily on seasonal climate—temperature, humidity, and regulation—so that the same day master thrives or fails by whether the month and assistants warm, cool, dry, or moisten it appropriately. It reduces many complex outcomes to a climate-adjustment logic. Therefore ‘poverty or success’ is largely thermodynamic balance of the natal season.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Stems are qi qualities sensitive to heat/cold and dryness/wetness. 2. Inference: Month branch sets the dominant climate regime. 3. Inference: Needed regulators (e.g., fire for cold, water for parched, etc.) act as medicine. 4. Inference: Harmful climate excess acts as pathology regardless of ‘noble’ gods in the wrong weather. 5. Conclusion: Ranking useful elements by seasonal medicine predicts passability of life path.","logic_practice":"1. Always diagnose chart climate before classical ten-god prestige. 2. Select yongshen as medicine for excess cold/heat/dry/wet. 3. Read luck cycles as climate shifts that deliver or withhold medicine. 4. Resolve contradictions: a ‘good’ officer in wrong climate may still fail. 5. For cultivation, align lifestyle (pace, diet, region, schedule) with the chart’s needed climate metaphorically and practically.","logic_compare":"Differs from 子平真诠 by making season/climate the primary axis rather than pure structural hierarchy of gods. Differs from 滴天髓 by being more schematic and medicinal in five-phase temperature, less purely abstract about flow poetry."},{"name_han":"子平真诠","logic_thesis":"The text proves that Zi Ping becomes correct when recentered on structural hierarchy: day master strength, month decree, useful/ facilitative/ harmful gods, and sequence of analysis—rather than on piled secret formulas. It claims ‘true interpretation’ means restored methodical structure. Therefore pedagogical clarity and ordered judgment are the path out of vulgar BaZi.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Corrupt practice multiplies techniques and loses the spine of method. 2. Inference: Month command and body strength determine what can be useful. 3. Inference: Ten gods must be ranked as yong/xi/ji relative to that structure. 4. Inference: Combinations and breaks are evaluated only after core structure is fixed. 5. Conclusion: A disciplined structural pipeline yields true Zi Ping readings.","logic_practice":"1. Freeze order: month → body strength → useful god → assistant → taboo → combinations → luck. 2. Do not name lucky elements until structure justifies them. 3. Use classic case patterns (e.g., official use, wealth use, output use) as templates. 4. Treat special rules as exceptions that must pass the pipeline. 5. Teach clients using structure language so advice matches mechanism.","logic_compare":"Unlike 渊海子平’s ocean of early materials, 真诠 is a purifying handbook of method. Unlike 穷通宝鉴, it privileges structural role of gods over climate medicine as the main key—though advanced practice often reconciles both."},{"name_han":"星平会海","logic_thesis":"The text proves that stellar (star-fate) systems and Zi Ping pillars are not rival monopolies but dual projections of one heavenly order that can be cross-validated when brought into a common sea of method. It argues that convergence of independent calculi raises confidence, while divergence flags timing or domain differences. Therefore integrated astrology is a triangulation strategy for destiny analysis.","logic_chain":"1. Premise: Multiple Chinese fate systems parse the same cosmos through different coordinates (pillars vs stars/palaces). 2. Inference: If both are lawful, they should often co-indicate major themes. 3. Inference: Integration (‘hui hai’) creates a fuller map: character/structure from pillars, domains/timing colors from stars. 4. Inference: Contradictions are data about scope (e.g., social vs inner, decade vs annual), not automatic nullification. 5. Conclusion: Joint reading is epistemically stronger than single-system absolutism when methodologically controlled.","logic_practice":"1. Cast Zi Ping structure first; freeze yongshen logic. 2. Cast star chart second; map career/wealth/relationship palaces as domains. 3. Accept only themes confirmed by both as high-confidence. 4. Use one system to time and the other to characterize when they specialize. 5. Avoid forced harmony: record divergences and test against life events to refine weights.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure Zi Ping classics (渊海/真诠/滴天髓), 星平会海’s thesis is inter-system validation. Unlike pure star manuals, it refuses stellar isolation. It differs from 三命通会’s encyclopedic BaZi breadth by specifically pursuing fusion logic across star and pillar coordinates."}]}
thought: The user wants me to extract logical reasoning from classical Chinese texts related to BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny), Feng Shui/geomancy, and physiognomy (face reading). entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that terrestrial fortune is not random decoration of landscape but a lawful transmission of cosmic qi through measurable form: heaven’s pattern becomes earth’s body, and body becomes human outcome. If qi has direction, concentration, and depletion, then burial and dwelling sites can be ranked by how well they store and release that qi. Therefore geomancy is a causal technology of qi economy, not omen-hunting.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Heaven’s qi moves by yin–yang and five-phase law and must settle into earth to become usable life-force. 2. Inference: Earth forms (mountains, waters, voids) are the only durable vessels that can receive, store, or leak that qi. 3. Inference: Where form gathers and water embraces without scattering, qi accumulates; where form breaks or water rushes, qi disperses. 4. Inference: Accumulated qi nourishes the living line; dispersed qi starves it. 5. Conclusion: Ranking sites by storage–release structure is a rational causal method for shaping lineage outcomes.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Map a site first as a qi circuit (source → path → store → exit), not as aesthetic scenery. 2. Prefer configurations where mountain backs store and water fronts contain, avoiding open leaks. 3. Treat burial/home placement as timing of release: too tight stagnates, too open drains. 4. In BaZi terms, read environmental support as external ‘season/root’ that can reinforce or starve a chart’s weak elements. 5. Reject purely symbolic names of peaks; demand form that actually holds wind and water.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 葬经翼, which elaborates burial craft after the classical axiom, 青囊经 states the first causal law itself: heaven–earth–man as one qi process. Unlike 青囊奥语, it argues principle more than operational formula, establishing why form matters before how to measure it.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that correct form alone is insufficient: directional degrees, mountain–water correspondence, and yin–yang pairing must lock into a single coordinate system or qi will be mis-assigned. It demonstrates that ‘sitting and facing’ are not aesthetic choices but algebraic relations between heavenly stems/branches and earthly landforms. Therefore error in orientation converts a good form into a wrong usage of qi.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Qi has both shape (form) and address (direction under the sexagenary/compass grid). 2. Inference: A form that stores qi still delivers it only along the facing/sitting axis that matches the mountain–water pair. 3. Inference: Mismatched mountain and water (or wrong degree) sends the stored qi to the wrong ‘palace’ of destiny. 4. Inference: Yin–yang and pure/impure lines must pair; unpaired lines cancel or invert benefit. 5. Conclusion: Geomantic validity is form × orientation × pairing, not form by itself.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Never score a site without measured sitting/facing degrees on a calibrated luopan logic. 2. Check mountain–water as a pair: water must ‘report’ to the mountain’s useful sector. 3. Separate pure and impure lines; do not mix formulas that assume different grids. 4. For BaZi integration, treat house orientation as a fixed external stem–branch field that biases yearly luck. 5. When form is good but life fails, audit orientation before abandoning the site.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 青囊经’s general qi economy, 天玉经 is the coordinate theorem: it proves addressability of qi. Compared with 都天宝照经, it is more abstract and pairing-centered, less a practical ‘mirror’ of case-like rules for reading bright hall and water exits.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the ‘bright hall,’ water mouth, and surrounding forms act as a readable instrument panel of fortune, not mystical scenery. By treating landscape as a system of intake, holding, and discharge, it shows outcomes can be predicted from how openly qi is received and how cleanly it exits. Thus feng shui judgment is diagnostic observation of circulatory health.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Usable qi must enter a bounded court, rest, then leave without tearing the vessel. 2. Inference: The bright hall is the reception chamber; too cramped or too wild ruins reception quality. 3. Inference: The water mouth is the control valve of discharge; its position and tightness regulate retention of wealth/rank qi. 4. Inference: Surrounding sand (hills) are walls of the vessel; broken walls equal leakage of social protection. 5. Conclusion: Reading hall–mouth–sand as one hydraulic system yields reliable ranking of sites.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Photograph/sketch the bright hall depth and openness before any formula talk. 2. Locate water exit relative to sitting mountain; treat it as the wealth lock. 3. Score enclosing hills as protection layers (left–right–front–back). 4. Prefer sites with calm intake and controlled exit over dramatic but leaking vistas. 5. In cultivation/BaZi use, treat a good hall as ‘seasonal support’ that stabilizes weak day-master expression.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 天玉经’s abstract pairing algebra, 都天宝照经 argues from visible circulatory anatomy—more phenomenological ‘mirror.’ Unlike 催官篇, it is general fortune diagnostics, not specialized promotion of official rank via specific form signatures.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that official rank is not generic ‘good feng shui’ but a specific morphological signature: forms that gather noble qi, open court for public recognition, and water/sand patterns that push career force rather than mere private wealth. It argues causality from shape-language of power (authority peaks, ceremonial halls, orderly attendants) to social elevation. Therefore career geomancy is a specialized subset of form science with its own evidence criteria.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Social rank is a public, hierarchical form of qi expression, not private accumulation alone. 2. Inference: Landscapes that resemble orderly courts, honor guards, and commanding peaks encode that hierarchical qi. 3. Inference: Water and road ‘approaches’ that bow and report generate recognition pathways; chaotic approaches generate litigation or obscurity. 4. Inference: Timing of burial/use can ‘urge’ (cui) latent noble qi into career manifestation. 5. Conclusion: Official success can be engineered by matching rank-shaped landforms plus activation timing.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Separate wealth-forms from rank-forms when auditing a site; do not confuse cash flow with office. 2. Seek orderly, upright peaks and ceremonial bright halls for career cases. 3. Check approach paths/waters for ‘reporting’ geometry toward the seat. 4. Use burial or renovation timing to catalyze, not only static form. 5. In BaZi, pair rank sites with charts that already have officer/kill structure so environment amplifies, not invents, capacity.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from 都天宝照经 by specializing the circulatory model into status outcomes. Differs from BaZi rank methods in 三命通会/子平真诠: here the proof object is land morphology as external officer-star, not natal stem–branch officer combinations.

entries.logic_thesis: Cai Yuanding’s text proves that feng shui’s true object is subtle pattern (li) and qi process, not vulgar tricks of shape-naming. It argues that only by tracing how yin–yang, five phases, and form–qi co-arise can one move from superstition to reasoned micro-analysis. Therefore ‘fa wei’ (revealing the subtle) is an epistemological reform: visibility of principle over rote secret formulas.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Popular geomancy often freezes forms into lucky/unlucky labels without causal process. 2. Inference: Real efficacy depends on li–qi dynamics: generation, control, balance, timing. 3. Inference: Form is the coarse body of qi; without reading subtle transitions, form-reading is incomplete. 4. Inference: Scholarly method must make those transitions explicit and teachable. 5. Conclusion: Geomancy is rehabilitated as rational investigation of subtle cosmic–terrestrial process.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For any rule, ask ‘what qi process does this encode?’ before applying it. 2. Prefer dynamic balance analysis (excess/deficiency, open/closed) over fixed taboo lists. 3. Train observation of micro-changes: wind turns, water speed, slope transitions. 4. Cross-check land analysis with BaZi seasonality language (same five-phase logic). 5. Discard secretisms that cannot state a causal chain.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 青囊奥语’s mnemonic formulas, 发微论 argues for transparent principle and intellectual purification. Unlike 青囊经, which founds the system mythically–axiomatically, it is Song rationalist methodology: why and how we know, not only that qi settles in form.

entries.logic_thesis: The preface proves that the Qingnang corpus is a transmission lineage with ordered method: heaven’s principle, earth’s application, and human use must be sequenced, or later techniques become orphaned tricks. It argues legitimacy of practice by genealogy of understanding—principle first, technique second. Therefore authority in geomancy is correct sequence of learning, not accumulation of secret tips.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Fragmentary techniques without framework produce contradictory judgments. 2. Inference: A proper ‘xu’ (ordering preface) establishes the map: cosmos → earth vessel → human timing. 3. Inference: Later formulas only work inside that map. 4. Inference: Transmission ethics require preserving sequence so students do not invert means and ends. 5. Conclusion: Methodological order is itself a causal condition of correct feng shui.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Teach/learn in order: yin–yang/five phases → form storage → compass pairing → case application. 2. When a formula conflicts, return to the higher premise in the sequence rather than stacking more tricks. 3. Use the preface as a checklist that each analysis has principle, form, and human timing layers. 4. In BaZi parallel, do not jump to special gods before chart structure is clear. 5. Audit your own practice for inverted sequence (tools before theory).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 青囊经 proper, which states cosmic axioms, 青囊序 argues the pedagogical and epistemological order of the system. Unlike 青囊奥语, it is not operational verse but meta-logic of how the school’s knowledge must be held together.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that Yang-school efficacy can be compressed into operational couplets: dragon, sand, water, and orientation interact by fixed generative rules that can be chanted and applied. It treats occult complexity as reducible to portable decision algorithms. Therefore the ‘mystery’ is not ineffability but condensed protocol for field use.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Masters need fast, stable rules under field conditions. 2. Inference: Complex qi relations can be encoded as short conditional verses (if dragon X and water Y, then Z). 3. Inference: Memorized protocols reduce interpretive drift between practitioners. 4. Inference: Practice fidelity becomes repeatability of the algorithm, not personal inspiration. 5. Conclusion: Geomantic art is transmissible as formulaic logic, not only as ineffable intuition.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Convert each couplet into an if–then checklist on site. 2. Verify dragon–water–sand–orientation as four independent inputs before concluding. 3. Use the verses as constraints that can falsify a ‘pretty’ but invalid site. 4. Pair with measurement (degrees, water exit) so poetry does not float free of data. 5. For BaZi, treat such protocols as analogous to structural yongshen rules: short, testable, hierarchical.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from 发微论 by prioritizing portable formula over philosophical unpacking. Differs from 天玉经 by being more mnemonic and applied; 天玉经 proves coordinate necessity, while 奥语 packages multi-factor decisions for workers in the field.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the body’s surface is a lawful map of inner qi, character, and destiny because form follows the same yin–yang/five-phase economy as heaven and earth. If facial bones, flesh, and spirit-color are stable expressions of that economy, then life outcomes can be inferred from structured signs rather than from caprice. Therefore physiognomy is a diagnostic science of embodied pattern, not carnival guesswork.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Human life is qi–form unity; character and fate are not purely invisible. 2. Inference: Face and body crystallize long-term qi states into readable morphology. 3. Inference: Hierarchy of signs exists (bone/spirit over temporary flesh/color). 4. Inference: Combinations and contradictions among signs yield nuanced, not one-feature, verdicts. 5. Conclusion: Systematic xiang can predict tendency of fortune and virtue with disciplined observation.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Read bone structure and spiritual light before scars, makeup, or mood. 2. Use five-phase face zoning (wood/fire/earth/metal/water regions) as elemental diagnostics. 3. Resolve conflicts by weighting permanent signs over transient ones. 4. Cross-check with BaZi: face as ‘phenotypic output’ of natal balance. 5. Never conclude from a single auspicious feature without whole-face synthesis.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 冰鉴, which is moral-psychological and elite-selection oriented, 麻衣神相 is classical full destiny physiognomy with stronger fate cataloguing. Unlike 柳庄相法, it is more foundational-legendary corpus than a later refined clinical system of weighted detail.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that physiognomy becomes more reliable when observation is standardized into fine-grained modules—features, proportions, spirit, and dynamic expression—with explicit weighting. It argues that accuracy rises by methodical decomposition and recombination rather than by mystical ‘overall feel’ alone. Therefore high-level xiang is an engineering of attention.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Global impressions are biased and non-replicable across readers. 2. Inference: Breaking the face into ordered feature modules reduces noise. 3. Inference: Assigning relative strength (main vs secondary signs) prevents equal false weighting. 4. Inference: Dynamic signs (voice, gait, spirit) update static bone readings. 5. Conclusion: A modular, weighted protocol yields more stable judgments of character and luck.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Follow a fixed exam order (spirit → bone → organs → color → motion). 2. Score each module and only then synthesize. 3. Let conflicting modules produce conditional predictions, not forced unity. 4. Use motion/spirit to validate whether ‘good bone’ is currently usable qi. 5. In BaZi counselling, treat modular xiang as life-stage feedback on whether the chart is expressing.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 麻衣神相, 柳庄 is more clinical-systematizing and less mythic. Compared with 神相全编, it is a coherent school method rather than a broad encyclopedia of many sources and techniques.

entries.logic_thesis: The compilation proves that physiognomic truth is distributed across many partial traditions and becomes stronger when collated, compared, and completed into a full reference system. It argues that no single thin manual covers the combinatorial space of human form; encyclopedic integration is required for professional coverage. Therefore completeness and cross-checking are epistemic virtues in xiang studies.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Human variation exceeds any short classic’s example set. 2. Inference: Multiple lineages capture different edge cases and feature logics. 3. Inference: Compilation allows triangulation when one school’s sign is ambiguous. 4. Inference: A ‘quan bian’ (complete compilation) functions as a decision library, not a single theorem. 5. Conclusion: Best practice is multi-source synthesis under unified five-phase principles.
entries.logic_practice: 1. When a case is odd, consult multiple modules (palm, face, body, moles) rather than forcing one classic. 2. Prefer agreements among independent sign systems as higher confidence. 3. Use the book as a library of differentials, not as contradictory oracles. 4. Map diverse signs back to one BaZi elemental story to avoid scatter. 5. Document which sub-tradition a rule comes from to prevent category errors.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from 麻衣/柳庄 as encyclopedic aggregation versus single-voice method. Differs from 相理衡真, which tries to weigh and purify principles toward ‘truth balance,’ whereas 全编 prioritizes breadth of coverage over critical filtration.

entries.logic_thesis: Zeng Guofan’s text proves that appearance is a practical instrument for reading moral fiber, talent type, and reliability under pressure—especially for selecting people—because spirit, bone, and qi-color reveal disposition more quickly than words. It is less about fatalistic fortune-telling than about risk management in human capital. Therefore physiognomy is justified as political–organizational epistemology.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Organizations fail when character is misread. 2. Inference: Speech is strategic; bodily spirit and structure are harder to fake continuously. 3. Inference: Categories of talent (steady, fierce, cunning, pure) map to observable constellations of features and demeanor. 4. Inference: Selection decisions improve by disciplined cold observation (‘ice’ clarity). 5. Conclusion: Xiang is a tool of governance and self-cultivation through knowing men—including oneself.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Observe silence, eyes, and bone before trusting rhetoric. 2. Match role requirements to talent type, not generic ‘good face.’ 3. Use xiang for risk flags (instability, cruelty, frailty) in partnerships. 4. Apply inward: correct your own qi-color via sleep, virtue, and posture (cultivation loop). 5. With BaZi, use 冰鉴 as interview layer validating chart-indicated character tendencies.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 麻衣神相’s destiny catalogs, 冰鉴 is selection ethics and talent typology for statesmen. Unlike 水镜集, its tone is Confucian-practical and terse, not primarily esoteric destiny elaboration.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that physiognomy needs a truth-balancing method: principles must be weighed against each other so that vulgar absolute rules are corrected by higher li. It argues that ‘true’ xiang is calibrated judgment under conflicting signs, not maximal collection of omens. Therefore hermeneutic balance is the core skill.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Many transmitted rules conflict when applied raw. 2. Inference: Without a balancing standard, practitioners oscillate or cherry-pick. 3. Inference: Higher principles (spirit over form, whole over part, enduring over transient) adjudicate conflicts. 4. Inference: ‘Heng zhen’ means continuous calibration toward reality, including moral reality. 5. Conclusion: Valid physiognomy is principled arbitration among signs, not sum of taboos.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Always state the conflict explicitly before resolving it. 2. Apply hierarchy: spirit/bone > flesh/color > isolated moles/marks. 3. Test a reading against known life facts to recalibrate weights. 4. Refuse lucrative absolute claims when balance is unclear. 5. In BaZi parallel, practice the same: balance useful god vs taboo god under season, not slogan rules.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 神相全编’s expansive compilation, 相理衡真 is critical and adjudicative. Unlike 柳庄’s modular protocol, it focuses on philosophical weighing when modules disagree—the meta-logic of truthfulness in reading.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that destiny-reflection works like a water mirror: the stiller and clearer the reflective medium (method and mind), the more accurate the image of a person’s fate-pattern. It binds technique to contemplative clarity, arguing that muddy desire distorts reading as much as wrong theory. Therefore xiang is both optical science of form and cultivation of the reader.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Reading is representation; representation fails when the mirror is turbid. 2. Inference: Technical rules are the mirror’s polish; moral/psychological stillness is the water’s calm. 3. Inference: Distorted motive (fear, greed, flattery) bends interpretation. 4. Inference: Clear method + clear mind yields high-fidelity mapping from form to life pattern. 5. Conclusion: Epistemic purity of the practitioner is part of the causal chain of accurate physiognomy.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Stabilize breath and motive before reading anyone. 2. Separate observation notes from evaluative judgment in two passes. 3. Re-check conclusions after emotional neutrality returns. 4. Use water-mirror metaphor in cultivation: clarify jing–qi–shen to clarify perception. 5. Integrate with BaZi without forcing client-pleasing narratives.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from 冰鉴 by more explicitly fusing contemplative metaphor with destiny reading. Differs from 麻衣’s external sign catalogs by stressing the reader’s internal condition as a validity condition of knowledge.

entries.logic_thesis: As ‘wings’ to the burial classic, the text proves that classical burial axioms become operational only when expanded into detailed mechanisms of dragon veins, points, sands, and waters with error analysis. It argues that incomplete application of 葬经 principles causes false blame of the classic rather than of technique. Therefore commentary-elaboration is necessary causal completion of theory.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Core burial classic states condensed laws of resting the dead to affect the living. 2. Inference: Real terrain is complex; without wings (detailed extensions), users misidentify points. 3. Inference: Detailed failure modes (false dragons, greedy points, leaking waters) explain bad outcomes. 4. Inference: Corrective elaboration restores the classic’s predictive power. 5. Conclusion: Geomantic classics require technical midrash to function as applied science.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Locate true dragon and true point with multi-factor confirmation, not single omen. 2. Study classic failure cases: beautiful form with wrong point. 3. Treat burial as systems engineering: protection, storage, drainage. 4. Use 葬经翼 as a debugging manual when classical expectations fail. 5. Link to BaZi timing for burial/move dates so form and time cohere.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 青囊经’s foundational axioms, 葬经翼 is applied expansion and troubleshooting. Unlike 催官篇’s rank specialization, it remains general burial-science completion of the classical line rather than a narrow career manual.

entries.logic_thesis: The work proves that destiny calculation becomes robust only when the three systems of fate discourse (and the vast combinatorial library of stem–branch cases) are integrated into one comprehensive reference. It argues that isolated techniques produce partial truths; encyclopedic synthesis under calendar cosmology yields professional completeness. Therefore BaZi mastery is corpus-level pattern recognition across many verified combinations.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Human natal patterns are combinatorially huge. 2. Inference: No short theory covers all interactions of gods, shrines, and structures. 3. Inference: A tonghui (complete assembly) stores precedent logic for rare charts. 4. Inference: Cross-section of schools allows correction of one-sided doctrines. 5. Conclusion: Reliable practice is theory + large case grammar, not theory alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Use it as a differential library when a chart’s pattern is uncommon. 2. Always re-derive a cited rule from structure before applying it blindly. 3. Compare multiple entries on the same topic to extract invariant logic. 4. Build personal case notes that update the book’s medieval priors. 5. Combine with modern timing practice carefully—prefer structural principles over archaic fatal lists.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 渊海子平, which founds Zi Ping method, 三命通会 is the massive consolidation layer. Unlike 滴天髓, it is less pure philosophical distillation and more encyclopedic coverage of gods, verses, and categories.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that destiny can be computed from the four pillars’ stem–branch structure by reading self (day master) against climate of month, roots, combinations, and useful relations—without relying solely on year-animal folklore. It establishes Zi Ping as a structural algebra of birth time. Therefore personal fate analysis is a chart-internal logic of balance and function.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Birth time fixes a four-layer stem–branch matrix of qi. 2. Inference: The day stem is the subject; other characters are environment and resources. 3. Inference: Strength and usefulness depend on month command, roots, and generation/control links. 4. Inference: Combinations, clashes, and deities/gods are operators on that structure. 5. Conclusion: Life tendencies follow from structural balance, not from isolated symbolic animals.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Identify day master and month command first every time. 2. Map roots and seasonal empowerment before listing lucky gods. 3. Determine what the chart needs (support, output, wealth, officer control) as functional demand. 4. Read luck cycles as changing climate over a fixed structure. 5. Reject year-only popular readings that ignore the matrix.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 子平真诠, 渊海子平 is the oceanic foundational curriculum; 真诠 later purifies structure-first method. Compared with 穷通宝鉴, it is broader structural Zi Ping rather than a climate/season specialist treatise on stem–branch temperature.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that true BaZi judgment is not stacking of auspicious labels but perceiving the living pattern of qi—when it flows, sticks, rebels, or transforms—through elegant structural insight. It argues that celestial ‘marrow’ is pattern recognition of balance and timing at a high abstraction. Therefore advanced destiny reading is poetic-precise philosophy of structure, not catalog of taboos.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Many schools drown in named gods while missing overall qi dynamics. 2. Inference: A chart is a living ecology: generating paths, blockages, and warps matter more than decorative stars. 3. Inference: Success comes when mechanism is understood (how wealth is taken, how officer is controlled). 4. Inference: Language of classics should point to mechanism, not replace it. 5. Conclusion: Highest skill is seeing marrow-level structure that explains all surface gods.
entries.logic_practice: 1. After standard setup, write the chart’s ‘story of flow’ in one paragraph without god-names. 2. Identify the main blockage or main engine first. 3. Evaluate ten gods only as roles inside that engine. 4. Use luck pillars as weather that enables or disables the mechanism. 5. In cultivation, treat the chart’s imbalance as a map of which virtues/practices restore flow.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 渊海子平’s foundational breadth, 滴天髓 is refined theory of insight. Unlike 子平真诠’s clean pedagogical structure of useful gods, it is more metaphysical-literary, demanding higher abstraction; 真诠 is clearer for stepwise training, 滴天髓 for master-level pattern vision.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that a stem’s fortune depends primarily on seasonal climate—temperature, humidity, and regulation—so that the same day master thrives or fails by whether the month and assistants warm, cool, dry, or moisten it appropriately. It reduces many complex outcomes to a climate-adjustment logic. Therefore ‘poverty or success’ is largely thermodynamic balance of the natal season.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Stems are qi qualities sensitive to heat/cold and dryness/wetness. 2. Inference: Month branch sets the dominant climate regime. 3. Inference: Needed regulators (e.g., fire for cold, water for parched, etc.) act as medicine. 4. Inference: Harmful climate excess acts as pathology regardless of ‘noble’ gods in the wrong weather. 5. Conclusion: Ranking useful elements by seasonal medicine predicts passability of life path.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Always diagnose chart climate before classical ten-god prestige. 2. Select yongshen as medicine for excess cold/heat/dry/wet. 3. Read luck cycles as climate shifts that deliver or withhold medicine. 4. Resolve contradictions: a ‘good’ officer in wrong climate may still fail. 5. For cultivation, align lifestyle (pace, diet, region, schedule) with the chart’s needed climate metaphorically and practically.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from 子平真诠 by making season/climate the primary axis rather than pure structural hierarchy of gods. Differs from 滴天髓 by being more schematic and medicinal in five-phase temperature, less purely abstract about flow poetry.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that Zi Ping becomes correct when recentered on structural hierarchy: day master strength, month decree, useful/ facilitative/ harmful gods, and sequence of analysis—rather than on piled secret formulas. It claims ‘true interpretation’ means restored methodical structure. Therefore pedagogical clarity and ordered judgment are the path out of vulgar BaZi.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Corrupt practice multiplies techniques and loses the spine of method. 2. Inference: Month command and body strength determine what can be useful. 3. Inference: Ten gods must be ranked as yong/xi/ji relative to that structure. 4. Inference: Combinations and breaks are evaluated only after core structure is fixed. 5. Conclusion: A disciplined structural pipeline yields true Zi Ping readings.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Freeze order: month → body strength → useful god → assistant → taboo → combinations → luck. 2. Do not name lucky elements until structure justifies them. 3. Use classic case patterns (e.g., official use, wealth use, output use) as templates. 4. Treat special rules as exceptions that must pass the pipeline. 5. Teach clients using structure language so advice matches mechanism.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 渊海子平’s ocean of early materials, 真诠 is a purifying handbook of method. Unlike 穷通宝鉴, it privileges structural role of gods over climate medicine as the main key—though advanced practice often reconciles both.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that stellar (star-fate) systems and Zi Ping pillars are not rival monopolies but dual projections of one heavenly order that can be cross-validated when brought into a common sea of method. It argues that convergence of independent calculi raises confidence, while divergence flags timing or domain differences. Therefore integrated astrology is a triangulation strategy for destiny analysis.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Multiple Chinese fate systems parse the same cosmos through different coordinates (pillars vs stars/palaces). 2. Inference: If both are lawful, they should often co-indicate major themes. 3. Inference: Integration (‘hui hai’) creates a fuller map: character/structure from pillars, domains/timing colors from stars. 4. Inference: Contradictions are data about scope (e.g., social vs inner, decade vs annual), not automatic nullification. 5. Conclusion: Joint reading is epistemically stronger than single-system absolutism when methodologically controlled.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Cast Zi Ping structure first; freeze yongshen logic. 2. Cast star chart second; map career/wealth/relationship palaces as domains. 3. Accept only themes confirmed by both as high-confidence. 4. Use one system to time and the other to characterize when they specialize. 5. Avoid forced harmony: record divergences and test against life events to refine weights.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure Zi Ping classics (渊海/真诠/滴天髓), 星平会海’s thesis is inter-system validation. Unlike pure star manuals, it refuses stellar isolation. It differs from 三命通会’s encyclopedic BaZi breadth by specifically pursuing fusion logic across star and pillar coordinates.
